content:
Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Result for 750 posts.

The examination was held on 02/08/2026. Candidates can check the result and official list through the IOB website and result link.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 07/07/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 27/07/2026
  • Exam Date: 02/08/2026
  • Result: 15/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS male: ₹944
  • General / OBC / EWS female: ₹708
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹236

Use the official IOB result link for the latest instructions.
